import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
import xgboost as xgb


def calculate_mean_column_wise_rmsle(y_true, y_pred):
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=float)
    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=float)
    col_rmsles = np.sqrt(np.mean((np.log1p(y_pred) - np.log1p(y_true)) ** 2, axis=0))
    return np.mean(col_rmsles)


# Load datasets
df_tr = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
df_te = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

target_cols = ["formation_energy_ev_natom", "bandgap_energy_ev"]
feature_cols = [c for c in df_tr.columns if c not in target_cols + ["id"]]

# Feature Engineering & Preprocessing
# Frequency encode spacegroup
sg_freq = df_tr["spacegroup"].value_counts(normalize=True)
df_tr["spacegroup_enc"] = df_tr["spacegroup"].map(sg_freq)
safe_mode = (
    df_tr["spacegroup"].mode().iloc[0] if not df_tr["spacegroup"].mode().empty else "P1"
)
df_te["spacegroup_enc"] = df_te["spacegroup"].fillna(safe_mode).map(sg_freq)
df_te["spacegroup_enc"].fillna(0.0, inplace=True)

numeric_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c != "spacegroup"]
preprocessed_cols = numeric_cols + ["spacegroup_enc"]

# Impute missing values
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="median")
df_tr[numeric_cols] = imputer.fit_transform(df_tr[numeric_cols])
df_te[numeric_cols] = imputer.transform(df_te[numeric_cols])

X_tr = df_tr[preprocessed_cols].values
y_tr = df_tr[target_cols].values
X_te = df_te[preprocessed_cols].values

# Hold-out validation split (80/20)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_tr, y_tr, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Train XGBoost Regressor with early stopping
model = xgb.XGBRegressor(
    n_estimators=1000,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    objective="reg:squarederror",
    verbosity=0,
)

model.fit(
    X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], early_stopping_rounds=30, verbose=False
)

# Evaluate on validation set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_score = calculate_mean_column_wise_rmsle(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Mean RMSLE: {val_score:.6f}")

# Retrain on full training data for final test predictions
best_iter = model.best_iteration if model.best_iteration < 1000 else 1000
final_model = xgb.XGBRegressor(
    n_estimators=best_iter,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    objective="reg:squarederror",
    verbosity=0,
)
final_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Generate predictions for test set
y_te_pred = final_model.predict(X_te)

# Format and save submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": df_te["id"],
        "formation_energy_ev_natom": y_te_pred[:, 0],
        "bandgap_energy_ev": y_te_pred[:, 1],
    }
)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully.")
